!define COMMAND_PATTERN {${PROJECT_ROOT}\Test\SlimVerify\_SlimVerify.BuildAndRunBehindProxy.bat ${TARGET_PLATFORM} ${VERIFY_DEATH_HOST_PORT}}

!2 The host is shot in the middle of the suite

This variant runs its host on ${VERIFY_DEATH_HOST_PORT}, not on the port of the other variants: that
gives it its own test system and its own process, so the page that shoots the host cannot take
!-ProxySuite-! down with it when the whole !-SlimProxyVerify-! suite is run at once.

The middle page kills the host process on purpose and then '''asserts''' what the proxy reports, so
this variant is green like every other one:

 * '''!-ABeforeDeathPage-!''' works against the living host,
 * '''!-BDeathPage-!''' kills it and checks that the proxy answers with a named cause instead of
   hanging,
 * '''!-CAfterDeathPage-!''' checks that a page after the death still runs and is still told the
   '''first''' cause,
 * and the suite runs '''to the end'''.

Without the proxy the run would simply break off at the death and the remaining pages would vanish
from the result without a page name.

!contents -R2 -g -p -f -h
